tools.description: ASM LLM tool interface (ASM_DESIGN section 6, WORKQUEUE T1): structured requests in JSON, XML, a documented YAML subset, TOML (tomllib, 3.11+), CSV (one flat row), or plain text; ops serve/list/inspect; expand reports unsupported_op until the abstraction ladder exists; responses echo the sniffed request format with --format as response-only override (csv responses are address/error rows; serve/inspect read back in the other formats; serve JSON is byte-identical with asm_main.py stdout); --schema emits the function-calling tool definition an LLM harness binds; exit 0 ok / 1 structured error document
tools.outputs: stdout response document (json/xml/yaml/toml/csv/txt) or tool-definition JSON via --schema; exit code
